# Docker Gotchas

> Known Docker / docker-compose image and orchestration patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [postgres:18 image rejects the classic /var/lib/postgresql/data mount](postgres-18-data-mount.md): postgres:18 stores data in a major-version subdir and wants the volume mounted at /var/lib/postgresql; the long-standing /var/lib/postgresql/data mount crash-loops the container. HIGH.
- [`docker compose exec -T` inside an ssh heredoc eats the rest of the script](compose-exec-stdin-heredoc-drain.md): exec -T (or any stdin reader) drains the remaining heredoc as its own stdin, silently skipping every later command; append `</dev/null` or run the script from a file. MEDIUM.
- [A deploy detector that filters OUT the known-bad signature fires on any transient error](deploy-detector-denylist.md): Denylist detectors fire on transient 5xx; use an allowlist for the expected-good response signature instead. HIGH.
- [Docker CPU limits must match the host runner's available CPUs](docker-cpu-limits-runner-compat.md): Container CPU limit in compose cannot exceed host capacity; building locally on more CPUs than the CI runner has fails deployment silently. Verify against runners with 2 CPUs. MEDIUM.
